g.text: Fixed-weight JEPA: prospective controller and recovery repair

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203343

g.text: 100 simulated robots × 60 s · 8 tested confirmation sites · 48 factual runs · no new fitting

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #516574

g.text: Legacy and repaired controllers pay the same actual-cost forecast rule. Every registered comparison remains visible.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: All six one-sided comparisons retain the 1 − 0.05/6 bound; both reduction lower bounds must exceed zero. Intervals use 20,000 whole-site bootstrap draws, conditional on fixed weights.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Pending commands are misses for the candidate and successes for the reference. Engineering tests cover worst-decile loss, silence, original video and bulk.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Source/causal/paid completion/offline replay integrity: True. Profile exceedances are paid capacity diagnostics under this NEW contract; older study vetoes remain unchanged.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Fast exact-integral-only arms are secondary ablations. Whole controller-package effects do not establish JEPA-objective necessity, hardware safety or SOTA.
